title: BACH 1.0: Multi-Shot AI Video Generation
summary: BACH is an industrial-grade video generation engine focusing on character stability and directorial control. It allows users to generate 30-second multi-shot films from a single text prompt with synchronized audio.
research_notes: Founded by former Tencent scientist Dr. Wei Liu; currently ranks #6 globally on the Artificial Analysis Video Arena benchmark.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from the 'BachVid' research paper (2025) to a full industrial launch in May 2026. It has since stabilized as a top-tier cinematic tool featuring a unique multi-shot 'Montage Mode' and 1080p native rendering.
